hero.title: From a classroom,
hero.lead: Good research does not stop halfway. The best product is not the most sophisticated one, but the one people actually use and feel the benefit of. The economy may be hard; with a solid ecosystem, we keep growing and making together.

loop.title: One cycle, three roles
loop.lead: Research comes home with problems and evidence. Engineering turns them into tools people can use. Outreach brings those tools to schools and small businesses. From the hands that use them, new stories are born — and become the next research. Insya' Allah.

research.title: Research
research.desc: We begin with questions from teachers, communities and small businesses. From the field we bring back responsible evidence, and make it the basis for the work.

engineering.title: Engineering
engineering.desc: We look after architecture, quality, releases and security. Every artifact comes with a clear license, a record of decisions and a self-host guide anyone can follow.

outreach.title: Outreach
outreach.desc: We introduce the tool with a demo, then stay with schools, communities and small businesses until they can stand on their own. We leave user notes behind so the know-how travels too.

loop.return: What we hear and see, we bring back to the R&D desk

pillars.title: Three pillars, one ecosystem
pillars.lead: Children, schools, small businesses. Different rooms, one ecosystem. We research the problem, prepare the tool, then make sure people actually use it. What they tell us becomes our next input.

kids.title: Coding for children
kids.desc: Computer programming for children. Computational thinking through Tantangan Bebras Sikecil, Siaga, Penggalang & Penegak and teacher training — and, in time, computer programming brought into coding clubs at schools.
kids.artifact: Learn to Code · Tantangan Bebras · Guide for Teachers

education.title: Education technology
education.desc: We accompany schools and educators in adopting learning technology — teacher training, hands-on support, and co-development with students.

economy.title: Economic technology
economy.desc: We research the needs of small businesses and economic literacy, then accompany them through UMKM Melek Data — from business planning to installing accounting and inventory tools. We stay until they can stand on their own.
economy.artifact: Islamic Economics Literacy · ERP · UMKM Melek Data

resources.title: Community resources
resources.lead: Open source, built to world-class standards. That means better software — tested, safer, and there for everyone.
resources.tag: We use it, we tend it

erp.title: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
erp.desc: Enterprise software for procurement, manufacturing, inventory, marketing, sales and accounting. We help install it, then stay until the people running it can carry on.

cms.title: Content & Education Management (CMS)
cms.desc: Content and education software for school information systems, student admissions and learning technology. Easy to use, able to wear its host's name, and developed with students and educators.

flagship.desc: The first work we let go into the open. A platform for practice and events in computational thinking through Tantangan Bebras questions — also an object of research, still tended today.

partnership.title: The way in
partnership.lead: Two doors lead to one table. Universities bring grants and research questions; schools, communities and small businesses bring needs from the field. We listen to both, then build together. What comes out does not stop with the first partner — the work stays open for anyone to use, build on and carry forward.

grant.title: Join Grant Program
grant.desc: Grants for shared needs. Everything they produce stays open: papers, aggregated data, code and products.

items.grant: Proposals written together, with the researcher as first author. The results are open to all: papers, code and the final product
items.fellow: Researchers sit as experts. We agree on the path to publication together, and we make sure it is testable from the start
items.product: Researchers get the code and product artifacts, plus the agentic workflow. The source stays open

engineering.title: Joint Engineering Program
engineering.desc: We stay with learning groups, boarding schools and small businesses from the problem to the solution — from the first install to independence.

items.beneficiary: Learning groups, boarding schools and small businesses as the people we accompany in using the tools — and free to join the development
items.mentoring: Our engineering team stays from installation until they are no longer needed
items.transfer: Train the trainer: we hand over the craft, not just the tools

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.lead: A community grown from research, engineering and outreach. Our focus: digital transformation through world-class open-source software. A research question, technology, a partner school, or a community that wants to grow together. Tell us — we want to hear it. Let's begin.

cta.lead: Tools can be used, modified and redistributed — simple yet strong and measurable, so getting started is easy.
